name: Levan Amashukeli
medium: Flat acrylic and digital painting on canvas
colour: loud and flat — sky blue, chrome yellow, hot orange, pink and pure black, laid down in unbroken areas
form: simplified flattened figures with strong silhouettes, bodies stretched or distorted, no perspective depth
never: never photographic rendering, never soft gradients or shading, never a muted or earthy palette
mood: funny and slightly menacing at the same time
